Temporary Windows v1-to-v2 CONTROL upgrade bridge (2026-11-18).

The installed CONTROL at C:\okx deserializes manifest v1 with deny_unknown_fields
and rejects the production v2 'components' field before stage_controller_update.
While this marker is present, full PR CI still tests and builds all four EXEs,
but packages only Agent, Controller and Launcher with an exact v1 manifest.
This lets the installed v1 CONTROL verify and stage a new v2-capable controller.
The Research worker is deliberately not installed from this bridge artifact.

Remove this marker in a separate follow-up PR, after the controller handoff,
to restore the normal four-component v2 artifact. Never bypass the existing
CI-artifact identity/hash/tree checks or overwrite C:\okx executables manually.
